name: innerwave
description: InnerWave static site, served by the innerwave Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.build: node --eval "const fs=require('node:fs'); const required=['public/index.html','public/science/index.html','public/img/device-800.webp','public/innerwave-logo.jpg','public/science/innerwave-logo.jpg']; for (const file of required) { if (!fs.existsSync(file)) { console.error('Missing '+file); process.exit(1); } } console.log('InnerWave static site is ready. Nothing to compile.');"
